secondary_research_refresh.screening_conclusion: Official ANOFM COMPETENT December 2025 newsletter reports conclusions of a completed August-November 2025 needs analysis across 36 counties. The analysis inputs include repeated employer vacancies, registered-unemployed profiles, training preferences, county CNSP forecasts, employer hiring estimates and county skill deficit/surplus. It reports digitalisation and administrative services as an upward trend in counties with urban agglomerations. The finding is promoted only as current qualitative complementary evidence; it does not become AI4WORK prevalence and contributes zero H1-H5 points. Project targets, course lists and training activity remain excluded as evidence of need.
